response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack/web developer, but the profile is a poor fit for this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, no networking security background (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching), and only brief, dated C/C++ experience (one ~6-month role in 2014-2015). His career has been focused on web platforms with TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than embedded firmware development.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with solid testing and CI/CD craftsmanship
Some low-level and performance-oriented experience (DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux)
Demonstrated ability to learn diverse stacks and work across web, mobile, desktop, and light embedded contexts
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a mandatory requirement for this role
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel, network switch, or security protocol (MACsec, 802.1X) experience
C programming experience is minimal and dated (~6 months in 2014-2015); career centered on web/full-stack work

key_factors.factor: No embedded/networking security or Linux kernel experience
Strong general engineering seniority and adaptability
